P.name: Death Defied
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Karthus''' enters a '''{{tip|zombie state}}''' for 7 seconds, during which he can cast his abilities at no cost. If ''{{ai|Defile|Karthus}}'' has been learned, it will remain toggled on for ''Death Defied's'' entire duration. ''{{ai|Requiem|Karthus}}'' becomes disabled after 4 seconds of the duration have elapsed.
P.description2: While under this state, '''Karthus''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} as well as prevents all incoming damage, but is also rendered unable to move, declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[Active ability items|activate items]].

Q.name: Lay Waste
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karthus''' conjures a blast at the target location that detonates after {{tt|{{rutngt|0.5}}{{minus}}{{rutngt|0.75}}|See notes}}, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within, {{ccs|doubled|magic}} when only one target is struck.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 116}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}}
{{st|Isolated Enhanced Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 116*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*2}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Wall of Pain
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karthus''' erects a wall of pain at the target location perpendicular to his facing that lasts 5 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} around its pillars and center.
W.description2: Enemies that touch the wall are inflicted with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|25% magic resistance reduction}}}} and become {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 5 seconds, decaying over the duration. This can affect enemies only once per cast.

E.name: Defile
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Karthus''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} whenever he kills an enemy.
E.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Karthus''' surrounds himself in a necrotic [[aura]] that deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to all nearby enemies.
E.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30/4 to 110/4}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Damage Per Second|{{ap|30 to 110}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
E.description3: Toggling ''Defile'' off triggers a final tick of damage. ''Defile'' is toggled off automatically if '''Karthus''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
E.description4: ''Defile cannot be toggled off during {{ai|Death Defied|Karthus}}.''

R.name: Requiem
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karthus''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for 3 seconds, then deals {{as|magic damage}} to all targetable enemy champions upon completion.
